title: Three-dimensional vectorial holography based on machine learning inverse design.
summary: Primary Results confirm experimental characterization of network-designed vectorial fields, alongside reconstructed holographic images. Admit the demonstrated optical result, without treating test-set accuracy as physical validation.
organization: Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München; RMIT University; University of Shanghai for Science and Technology
